From 70998c5c67ddd08af458f0f29aa5830a0729a0c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Derek Bruening <bruening@google.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2018 01:05:48 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] i#975 static DR: fix Mac build (#2856)

Fixes a Mac build error introduced by 3bc33154.
Fixes a Mac test build error that shows up on newer toolchains.

Issue: #975

diff --git a/core/unix/module.c b/core/unix/module.c
index 91865b744..e4c635e43 100644
--- a/core/unix/module.c
+++ b/core/unix/module.c
@@ -33,8 +33,8 @@
  */
 
 #include "../globals.h"
-#include "module_private.h"
 #include "../module_shared.h"
+#include "module_private.h"
 #include "os_private.h"
 #include "../utils.h"
 #include "instrument.h"

diff --git a/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c b/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
index a71f043da..f5cffd684 100644
--- a/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
+++ b/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 /* **********************************************************
- * Copyright (c) 2017 Google, Inc.  All rights reserved.
+ * Copyright (c) 2017-2018 Google, Inc.  All rights reserved.
  * **********************************************************/
 
 /*
@@ -90,9 +90,10 @@ GLOBAL_LABEL(FUNCNAME:)
         mov      REG_XDI, REG_XBP
         sub      REG_XDI, 12
         mov      [REG_XBP - 80], REG_XBP
-        jmp      test
+        /* We can't use "test" as a label on Mac NASM. */
+        jmp      test_start
 
-     test:
+     test_start:
         mov      REG_XCX, [REG_XDI + 12]
         mov      REG_XDX, [REG_XBP - 72]
         mov      REG_XBX, [REG_XBP - 80]
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `core/unix/module.c`**
   - The include directive for `"module_private.h"` was moved from below to above the include for `"module_shared.h"`. This change ensures that the private module header is included before the shared module header, which may resolve dependencies or compilation issues.

2. **File: `suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c`**
   - The copyright notice was updated to reflect the years 2017-2018 instead of just 2017.
   - The label `test` was renamed to `test_start` to avoid conflicts with the label name on Mac NASM, which does not allow the use of "test" as a label. The jump instruction was updated accordingly to point to `test_start`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `core/unix/module.c` and `suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c` are both aimed at fixing build issues on Mac systems. The change in `module.c` addresses a build error that was introduced in a previous commit, while the changes in `memval-test.c` resolve a test build error that arises from using a restricted label name in Mac NASM. Together, these modifications ensure that the code compiles and runs correctly on Mac platforms, addressing specific issues that were encountered with newer toolchains.
